name: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of filter materials and flue gas purification series environmental protection products in China and internationally. It offers dust removal filter materials and flue gas denitrification catalysts. The company’s products are used in electricity, steel and coking, waste incineration, cement, chemicals, small boilers, and new energy industries. Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.
